items.title: Horse tram 'Tramways Nord / St-Denis' cut out of P2
items.author: Detroit Publishing Co. / Photoglob Zürich (Photochrom), c.1890-1900 (cutout made for this work)
items.license: Public domain (no known restrictions; Photochrom, Detroit Publishing Co., c.1890-1900)
items.what_it_shows: Tram body with roof deck/canopy, destination board 'St DENIS', side 'TRAMWAYS ... NORD'; two lamp-posts and a man in a bowler hat stand in front and are kept as part of the card
items.method: Crop (1051,1764,1764,2103) of the 3650 px master TIFF; hand polygon [[150, 118], [245, 104], [400, 103], [662, 107], [676, 128], [668, 142], [668, 300], [668, 318], [560, 320], [250, 322], [200, 320], [152, 320], [152, 142], [140, 132]] (crop coords) as GC_PR_FGD with body/canopy rect (140,100,672,302) as GC_FGD; cv2.grabCut 6 iters with mask init; largest component, holes <400 px filled; hard mask eroded 1 px, Gaussian sigma 0.55 feather; edge band colours replaced from interior (cv2.inpaint TELEA) to remove cream background halo
items.halo: soft alpha band within 2.32 px (chamfer L2, i.e. <=2 px Euclidean: erode 1 + feather sigma 0.55 + dilate 1) of the solid core; colour decontaminated
items.used_as: V everywhere (L1 composited far plane, L3 composited at the stop); in L2 the same pixels are native to P2. V_tram.png is ungraded source colour; V_tram_graded.png carries the P2 plate grade (luma p50 35, it is a dark-bodied tram). Not mirrored.

items.title: Plane trees and cast-iron lamp-post, rue Royale, cut out of P1
items.author: Detroit Publishing Co. / Photoglob Zürich (Photochrom), c.1890-1900 (cutout made for this work)
items.license: Public domain (no known restrictions; Photochrom, Detroit Publishing Co., c.1890-1900)
items.what_it_shows: Row of plane-tree crowns over the left pavement of rue Royale with a trunk and a gas lamp-post at the base
items.method: Crop P1_band.png crop [100, 60, 700, 980] (band y0=1013 in 3744x2816 TIFF); hand polygon + green-foliage HSV seed as GC_FGD, sky strip GC_BGD; grabCut; pale facade pixels (S<70,V>140) removed from the crown; same 1 px feather + decontamination as V
items.halo: soft band p99 2.32 px (chamfer); isolated specks up to 4.2 px
items.caveat: left and right edges are straight crop/scissor edges (the tree row continues in the photo): enter it from a frame edge or let the straight edge read as a scissor cut; a small awning patch is kept under the crown
items.used_as: S2 foreground plane at 1.4x parallax (fg_plane_graded.png carries the P1W grade)

absences.searched: Sharper PD/CC colour photo of a Paris horse tram or omnibus with impériale: LoC photos q='paris omnibus' (27 results), 'paris tramway' (11), 'photochrom paris avenue opera'
absences.result: only LoC 2005694563 (1886, 'No known restrictions on publication.'): B&W, tiny omnibus in a printed collage mount; rejected. No colour photochrom of a tram larger than P2's.

absences.searched: Commons: Category:Horse-drawn_omnibuses_in_Paris (empty/nonexistent), file search 'omnibus hippomobile Paris'
absences.result: 40 titles found (mostly Gallica Agence Rol B&W, 1910-1932, e.g. 'Tramway hippomobile CGO.jpg', 'Omnibus à Paris en 1900 (ligne de Montmartre à Saint-Germain-des-Prés).jpg', '13 septembre 1910, station omnibus, place de la Concorde (... omnibus à étage découvert) - btv1b6914761g.jpg'). Licences NOT read: Commons API returned 429 on every extmetadata call (backed off 3-20 s, 4 tries). Not used. Also B&W and a different vehicle, so it would break the 'one vehicle V' invariant against P2's native colour tram.

absences.decision: V = P2 master-TIFF tram (533x218 px cut at 3650 px source, ~3.6x the 1024 file's ~150 px), used everywhere. P3's native impériale trams are available as same-era corroboration in L3.

absences.searched: LoC IIIF larger-than-1024 JPEGs for P1/P3/P4
absences.result: IIIF info.json for the 'v' JPEGs is 1024 px max; 'u' master TIFFs are ~31 MB each, so only row bands were fetched by HTTP Range (P1 14.2 MB, P3 11.7 MB; total new download ~26 MB). P4 kept at 1024 (control only).
